## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` is green
- [ ] A changeset is added for changes to a published package (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] Docs are updated for changes to config, routes, the element contract or the renderer contract
- [ ] No server-only code (`*.server.*`, `server/`) reaches a client bundle
